plan: Given this is the first and only round, I need to maximize profit based on my current value. The optimal strategy in a second-price auction (where you pay the second-highest bid) is to bid your true value. This ensures you win when your value is higher than others and never pay more than your value.

I will bid my true value of $18. This is a dominant strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction, meaning it maximizes my profit regardless of what other bidders do. By bidding my value, I ensure that I only win if the second-highest bid is less than my value, guaranteeing a positive profit.

This is a single-round auction, so long-term strategy isn't applicable beyond maximizing profit in this round. The optimal strategy in a Vickrey auction (second-price sealed-bid) is to bid your true value. Bidding less risks losing to a bid lower than your value, while bidding more risks winning and paying more than your value. Therefore, I will bid my true value to maximize my expected profit.
